about: Purchase your copy of the RetroRealms Double Feature: Halloween and Ash vs Evil Dead bundle and receive two additional playable characters: Laurie Strode from “Halloween” and Kelly Maxwell from “Ash vs Evil Dead”! Each character includes their own play style, story, and achievements to unlock! Offer expires on November 17, 2024.
Enter the RetroRealms™ and take control of iconic horror characters in two separate games filled with over-the-top arcade action!

Step into a 16-bit Pixel Art world filled with gory good fun as horror legends Michael Myers and Ash Williams! Slice and shoot your way across multiple levels of terrifying platformer action filled with familiar sights and sounds from both the original “Halloween” film and the STARZ television series “Ash vs Evil Dead”! Test your skill, use your weapons, and confront twisted and fiendish versions of iconic characters in two separate games in one Double Pack that can be connected for even more fun. Engage in epic, heart-pounding encounters to overcome the ultimate evil in this sprawling adventure filled with over-the-top terror!
Play as Horror Icons Michael Myers and Ash Williams (both games included):

Journey into worlds where nightmares manifest, filled with treacherous landscapes and unspeakable horrors. Overcome obstacles, enemies, and bosses that lay in your path to save yourself from eternal damnation!
Immerse yourself in Pixel Art-styled 16-bit visuals and a hauntingly nostalgic horror soundtrack. RetroRealms pays homage to classic side-scrollers while delivering a fresh take on retro gameplay.
Discover hidden relics and collectibles. Unlock new power-ups and abilities to enhance your character’s skills, and discover all-new ways play.
summary: Purchase your copy of the RetroRealms Double Feature: Halloween and Ash vs Evil Dead bundle and receive two additional playable characters: Laurie Strode from “Halloween” and Kelly Maxwell from “Ash vs Evil Dead”!
